title: OTel Collector capture policy
description: Shape a capture policy file (metadata-only.yaml, content-approved.yaml) must match. See otel/docs/OTEL_PLAN.md Phase 3 and otel/docs/SEMCONV.md section 7. This schema is documentation/config-review tooling only — the Collector itself never reads these YAML files directly; otel/policy/apply.sh reads captureMode from one and renders it into an environment variable the Collector process picks up on next start. See otel/policy/README.md for why a Collector restart (never an application restart) is currently how a policy switch takes effect.

captureMode.description: metadata-only (default): gen_ai.input.messages / gen_ai.output.messages are deleted before export — current behavior exactly, unconditionally, as it has been since before this policy layer existed. content-approved: those two attributes are permitted to reach the backend. gen_ai.system_instructions is excluded under every policy tier — no captureMode value re-enables it (see otel/docs/SEMCONV.md section 7).

description.description: Human-readable note on what this policy file does. Not consumed by the Collector.

updatedBy.description: Who/what last edited this file. Not consumed by the Collector.

updatedAt.description: When this file was last edited. Not consumed by the Collector.
